newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey sells dollars for lira, bankers say.
newsitem.headline: Turkey sells dollars for lira, bankers say.

text.p: Turkey's central bank has sold dollars for Turkish lira on the interbank to curb the dollar's rise against the local currency caused by falling interest rates and a cash surplus, bankers said on Wednesday.
They said the dollar sales, which began at around 98,000 lira per dollar, had strengthened the lira to 97,700 to the dollar.

The central bank acted after the lira weakened to 98,140 in the morning, depressed by a swing to dollar buying by investors facing a cash surplus in the market after an undersubscribed T-bill auction on Tuesday.
Overnight interest rates fell five pct points to 70 percent in the morning, which also pushed up the dollar. But bankers said interest rates had picked up to 74.75 percent in the afternoon.
